lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: طَحَىٰهَا is in the derivative form: طَحا
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ط/ح/و-ى   ṭ–ḥ–w/y wide, expansive, level land, to stretch out, to expand, to spread out. Of this root, طَحا ṭaḥā occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
طَحا ṭaḥā ū [v. trans.] to spread out, to stretch out

(91:6) وَالأَرْضِ‏ ‏وَمَا‏ ‏طَحَاهَا and by the earth and how He spread it.
